apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.14 — Two fixes: playing a raga now stops a LoopLab song (the Raga browser gained the same play-start hook Varisai and Tala have), and background playback is properly enabled — the background-audio mode was declared in the project but never landed in the built app, so the song stopped when the app went to the background; a real Info.plist now carries it. Also carries v1.5.13 dynamic note blending.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
